title: Morgan Weistling
description: Morgan Weistling painted this outstanding piece (front, collection of William Plumb) for a collectors plate for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. But the artist is a perfectionist and withdrew the work. "l too am a lover of the STAR WARS trilogy and felt it deserved better," he said. "I feel my second shot represents the movie much better." The finished plate (back) is dazzling.
